visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up, static shot of a light blue Mickey Mouse-themed tote bag. A person's hand opens the bag to reveal the interior lining, which is marked with several distinct yellowish-brown stains on the white bottom fabric. (2) The scene cuts to a brightly lit retail store aisle, possibly a POYA branch. A woman with long brown hair, wearing a white top, stands before a shelf full of Christmas merchandise. A young girl in a red GAP shirt reaches for a green 'Merry Christmas' surprise bag from the shelf. (3) The setting shifts to an indoor living room with a gray sofa. Two children, a boy in a striped shirt and the girl from before, are seated. A green gift bag is placed in front of them as adult hands enter the frame to begin the unboxing process. (4) In a series of rapid cuts, various items are pulled from the bag: a black lunch bag in plastic wrap, several packs of shaped erasers, a set of neon liquid chalk markers, two B5 sized notebooks, a blue foldable tote bag, a cat-shaped liquid keychain, a squishy fruit toy, and a pink double-layered pencil case. (5) The final phase shows all items spread out across a surface for a complete inventory view. The camera pans across the collection of stationery and lifestyle accessories to conclude the showcase.
